note: Trigger-routing suite for the new default-orchestration-protocol pack (issue #480, minted from the #373 overnight campaign). Positives across the six areas (coordination scope ladder, work-claim protocol, communication routing, version-slot/merge-order, session-death resilience, pin-race playbook). Negatives drawn from the fenced siblings' own trigger vocabulary: parallel-work-rules (isolation decision / live collision), team-or-solo-rules (dispatch shape/wiring), loop-rules (continuation timing), mobilize-chores (which tickets are mobilizable), and big-change-git-rules (stacked-PR/rename git mechanics, cross-plugin) — plus a same-plugin agent-writing-rules probe (encoding the delivery clause into an agent file, not applying the runtime default).
